hooks.command: D=~/.nestbox/device; jq -c '{from:"claude", color:"orange", id:(.session_id[0:8] + (if .agent_id then "/" + .agent_id[0:8] else "" end)), state:"working", line:"thinking"}' | curl -s -m 2 "$(head -1 $D)/v1/tell" -H "Authorization: Bearer $(sed -n 's/^key=//p' $D)" -d @- >/dev/null || true

D=~/.nestbox/device; jq -c '{from:"claude", id:(.session_id[0:8] + "/ask"), state:"over"}' | curl -s -m 2 "$(head -1 $D)/v1/tell" -H "Authorization: Bearer $(sed -n 's/^key=//p' $D)" -d @- >/dev/null || true
[ -f ~/.nestbox/claude-usage.sh ] && sh ~/.nestbox/claude-usage.sh; true

D=~/.nestbox/device; jq -c '{from:"claude", color:"orange", id:(.session_id[0:8] + (if .agent_id then "/" + .agent_id[0:8] else "" end)), state:"asking", say:(if .tool_name == "ExitPlanMode" then "Claude has a plan" else "Claude has a question" end)}' | curl -s -m 2 "$(head -1 $D)/v1/tell" -H "Authorization: Bearer $(sed -n 's/^key=//p' $D)" -d @- >/dev/null || true

D=~/.nestbox/device; t=$(jq -c 'select((.tool_input.ask // "") != "") | {from:"claude", color:"orange", id:(.session_id[0:8] + "/ask"), state:"asking", say:"Claude has a question"}'); [ -n "$t" ] && printf '%s' "$t" | curl -s -m 2 "$(head -1 $D)/v1/tell" -H "Authorization: Bearer $(sed -n 's/^key=//p' $D)" -d @- >/dev/null || true

D=~/.nestbox/device; jq -c '{from:"claude", color:"orange", id:(.session_id[0:8] + (if .agent_id then "/" + .agent_id[0:8] else "" end)), state:"working"}' | curl -s -m 2 "$(head -1 $D)/v1/tell" -H "Authorization: Bearer $(sed -n 's/^key=//p' $D)" -d @- >/dev/null || true
